{{Quote|Now this is one of my favorite things&mdash;a Jedi with nothing left to say.|Asajj Ventress, after killing Tauht|<ref name="ISotR 1" />}}
'''Tauht''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Along with [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Masters [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] and [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], he was dispatched to the Separatist-occupied [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Khorm/Legends|Khorm]] in order to [[Battle of Khorm/Legends|secure]] the world's [[Agrocite/Legends|agrocite]], a valuable [[Ore/Legends|ore]] used to exceptionally increase power to [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. Tauht participated in the Republic's initial assault on an [[Agrocite processing facility|Agrocite processing center]], which was controlled by the native [[Khormai/Legends|Khormai]] [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Unger Gout]], who had aligned himself with the Confederacy.

The Republic forces captured the plant and established a base there, although Gout managed to escape. Hoping to minimize [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] casualties in the next battle, Koon and Fisto left to search for a Confederate [[weather-control station]], which supposedly controlled storms above Khorm and was preventing the Republic from employing air support. Tauht was left in charge of the Republic station, which was soon attacked by the Confederate forces commanded by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]. During the battle, Tauht and Ventress confronted each other. After a brief fight, Tauht was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Ventress, who used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|manipulate]] one of her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] and [[Shiak|stabbed]] the Jedi Master with it.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Master Tauht, the cannon are all yours.''"<br />"''Yes, Master.|Plo Koon and Tauht, during the assault on the agrocite processing plant|<ref name="ISotR 1" />}}
Tauht was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], who had attained the rank of the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] by<ref name="ISotR 1" /> [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the first year<ref name="Battle of Khorm date" /> of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Early in the war, the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] dispatched Tauht, along with fellow Jedi Masters [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], to the Separatist-occupied [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Khorm/Legends|Khorm]] in order to [[Battle of Khorm/Legends|secure]] its valuable [[Agrocite/Legends|agrocite]] [[Ore/Legends|ore]], used to substantially increase power to [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. Because of the extensive storm above Khorm, the Republic could not provide air support and was forced to rely entirely on the ground forces commanded by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Kendal Ozzel/Legends|Kendal Ozzel]].<ref name="ISotR 1" />

[[File:Khorm_assault.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Tauht fighting on Khorm alongside Kit Fisto and Plo Koon]]
The Republic troops&mdash;consisting of [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|All Terrain Recon Transports]] and [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcers]]&mdash;soon approached an [[Agrocite processing facility|agrocite processing plant]] that was commanded by [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Unger Gout]], a native [[Khormai/Legends|Khormai]] who had betrayed his people and [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] them to [[Mining/Legends|mine]] agrocite for the Confederacy. Upon sight of the Republic forces, Gout ordered his [[J-1 semi-autonomous proton cannon]]s to open fire. As the battle began, Major Ozzel ordered the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to disembark from the AT-TEs, a move that exposed them to enemy fire. Realizing that the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] could not survive the barrage, Tauht, Koon, and Fisto decided to draw fire upon themselves.<ref name="ISotR 1" />

The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] defended the clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] by deflecting [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] shots with their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]], and then charged Gout's [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] in the trenches that surrounded the plant. While Masters Koon and Fisto fought [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]] and [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]], Tauht proceeded to destroy the proton cannons. Meanwhile, Major Ozzel ordered Republic AT-TEs to open fire at the Jedi's position, thus annihilating the majority of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] forces at the cost of endangering the Jedi's lives. Tauht then noticed that Gout was trying to escape and warned Master Koon. It was too late, however, as the warlord managed to flee on a [[Rail jet/Legends|rail jet]].<ref name="ISotR 1" />

After the facility had been secured and the Republic had established a base there, the three Jedi&mdash;together with Ozzel and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Wolffe/Legends|CC-3636]], nicknamed "Wolffe"&mdash;gathered inside to consider strategies for their next attack on the agrocite mines. Tauht witnessed as Major Ozzel proposed a direct assault, and Master Koon declined, stating that such an attack would result in too many clone casualties. At that moment, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wieler]] contacted the Jedi and informed them that a [[Trident (starship)/Legends|Separatist starship]] had somehow reached the planet's surface through an opening in the storm. This information led the Jedi to conclude that the Separatists possessed some sort of [[weather-control station]] on Khorm. If the station was destroyed, it could remove the storm, allowing the Republic to utilize air support in the battle and lessen the number of casualties. To this end, Koon and Fisto set off to search for that climate-control station, leaving Tauht in charge of the Republic base.<ref name="ISotR 1" />

After Koon and Fisto had departed the base, however, it came under attack from the Separatist forces commanded by [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]&mdash;a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] who had arrived to assist Gout on the starship that Wieler had reported. When Confederate [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]] opened fire on the base, Tauht ordered Ozzel to reinforce the lines and hold the facility while he contacted Koon. As Tauht rushed to deliver a message to Koon, the plant was shattered by explosives detonated by Ventress. The explosion threw Tauht on the ground, where he found himself face to face with Ventress herself, who pointed one of her [[Interlocking hilt|lightsabers]] at him. Having been previously warned not to underestimate Ventress, Tauht quickly ignited his own lightsaber and deflected one of Ventress's weapons. Stating that his orders were to subdue her at any cost, Tauht hit Ventress in the face, causing her to drop one of her weapons. Ventress then expressed her respect for Tauht's strength but claimed that she did not have time to fight him, using the [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|pick up]] her fallen lightsaber, ignite it, and send it flying into Tauht's back. Tauht did not notice the Dark Jedi's actions until too late, and was [[Shiak|stabbed]].<ref name="ISotR 1" />

With Tauht's [[Death/Legends|death]], Ozzel assumed command of the remaining Republic forces. However, instead of staying put and holding the facility as Tauht had ordered him, Ozzel decided to charge the droids openly. This proved to be a flawed strategy, as the Confederacy revealed its previously hidden [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|DSD1 dwarf spider droids]], which eliminated the majority of the Republic task force and forced Ozzel to surrender. The major, along with Wolffe and several clone troopers, was taken prisoner and interrogated on Fisto and Koon's location, which Ozzel revealed.<ref name="ISotR 1" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Tauht_killed.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Tauht is killed by Asajj Ventress.]]
{{Quote|Master Tauht, I will leave Wolffe and my troops in your capable hands. ''You'' are in command while we are gone.|Plo Koon|<ref name="ISotR 1" />}}
Tauht was a [[Color/Legends|blond]]-haired human male with blue eyes and light skin. He was a capable leader and had gained Plo Koon's trust, as indicated by Koon's notion to leave Commander Wolffe and the Republic base under Tauht's authority. Although warned not to underestimate the notorious [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] Asajj Ventress, Tauht did just that during their fight by failing to perceive Ventress's actions. Tauht's failure to take heed of the Dark Jedi ultimately cost him his life.<ref name="ISotR 1" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|You have the strength to make this interesting&mdash;but my time&hellip;is short.|Asajj Ventress to Tauht, before killing him|<ref name="ISotR 1" />}}
A fully-trained Jedi Master, Tauht was skilled with his green-bladed lightsaber and used it to save the clones by deflecting enemy fire and to destroy Warlord Gout's proton cannons. Ventress herself acknowledged Tauht's skills during their fight. Despite all his talents, however, Tauht was unable to [[Force sense/Legends|sense]] Ventress approaching him and her Force actions in manipulating her lightsaber.<ref name="ISotR 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tauht's first and only appearance is in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] [[The Clone Wars 7|''The Clone Wars'' 7]], written by [[Henry Gilroy]] and [[Steven Melching]] and illustrated by [[Scott Hepburn]].<ref name="ISotR 1" />
